title: centaurea alba subsp. aristifera
intro: Centaurea alba subsp. aristifera, commonly known as White Knapweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) characterized by its white or pale pink flowers and tall, upright stems. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of White Knapweed include its ability to reduce inflammation, relax muscles, and exhibit sedative effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of White Knapweed include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
